Nagaland Protest Sparks Demand for Probe into Killings

Protests in Manipur have led to demands from the Nagaland community for an investigation into killings following a black-flag protest. The protests, which began after six Naga men were killed, have highlighted tensions between different communities in the region. The issue has sparked concerns about the safety and well-being of the Naga population.
